x: Jock Martin, a stalwart for many years in this race, was indisposed, as was also Fred Rickards. Readman and Roberts were also prevented from entering and we could only muster six entries against last year's eleven.
Jock Martin has recently moved to Hounslow West. Hopes to get along and meet some of his old friends.
Heartiest Congratulations to Colin Sutton and Jock Martin upon their performances in the 24 Hours' Walk, held at the White City on July 14th-15th.
